scope: Tracked codec and format groups, not an exhaustive inventory of every VLC codec, profile, container or protocol.

items.name: Microsoft Video 1
items.detail: Original 8/16-bit decoder, delta frames and AVI checkpoint cache passed exact golden, malformed, concurrent seek and production video-output tests.
items.next: Broaden palette-change and edge/orientation variants; obtain more independent conformance streams.

items.name: PGS bitmap subtitles
items.detail: Original decoder passed RLE/composition goldens and production Matroska bitmap placement, clear, selection, delay, backward seek and resize checks.
items.next: Broaden real-stream conformance and extended profiles. VobSub/DVB remain separate missing implementations.

items.name: Microsoft ADPCM
items.detail: Original WAVE tag 2 decoder passed exact goldens, native reference prefixes, PCM round-trips and production pause/seek/rate/volume transport checks.
items.next: Broaden independent encoders and unusual block/coefficient edge cases.

items.name: ProRes native playback verification
items.detail: Six standard ProRes profiles and H.263 passed native pixel decode/seek comparison plus actual production player output and seek.
items.next: Native routes only; high-bit-depth/alpha/RAW and other carriers remain unverified.

items.name: Windows desktop preview
items.detail: Expanded Windows source now includes original AIFF/AIFC/AU, MKV AVC/HEVC+AAC-LC remux, audio selection and embedded plain text. Portable and independent decode checks pass; new native Windows review validation is in progress. Full VLC compatibility is not complete.
items.next: Review the next Windows x64 artifact and real-device audio. Unimplemented and unverified families are tracked in Windows/CodecSupport.json.

items.name: Windows AIFF/AIFC and AU audio
items.detail: 60 exact original sample vectors, chunk/order/endian/depth/rate limits, source-depth WAV round-trips, malformed inputs and cancellation pass. Physical Windows audio output remains a separate unverified check.
items.next: Broaden real encoders and physical audio hardware coverage.

items.name: Windows Matroska and MP4 remux
items.detail: Own bounded EBML demux, ISO mux, rational B-frame timeline, selectable AAC-LC/audio-off and embedded readable captions. Independent native decoding matched AVC360, reorderedAVC360, HEVC8/10×60 frames exactly; AAC offset within25ms.
items.next: New native Windows MKV/B-frame/caption tests, HEVC availability probes and real-device A/V checks. Missing profiles and containers remain explicit.

items.name: Windows playback recovery
items.detail: Media request instance/generation guards, caption request revisions, 30-second native-open timeout, retry from Play, Escape cancellation, worker cleanup and audio-switch origin adjustment implemented.
items.next: Run Windows production UI regression suite for failed/repaired input, captions, fullscreen and seek.
